buildings.name: 25 Flatbush Avenue
buildings.form: load-bearing appearance; five-storey commercial loft with a bracketed metal cornice, masonry piers, stone bands, large second-storey display windows and upper sashes. Construction system not established.
buildings.limitations: The 21 Flatbush / lot 24 exposure is a substitute card. The building is visible beside lots 26 and 19. The April 1989 certificate for 19-27 Flatbush (alteration 1858/85, completed 24 March 1989) specifies three stores and offices on floors 2-5. It reports 45 ft, versus 69.87 ft in the later footprint survey. The scene uses the latter as a roofline proxy, not a verified 1990 height. Period storefront finishes and the extent of the alteration remain uncertain.

buildings.name: 1 Flatbush Avenue
buildings.form: Low corner restaurant with a clipped prow, strip windows, projecting striped fascia and paired pole signs.
buildings.limitations: Sign wording is legible in the photograph; the 1993 permit corroborates the owner, not the exact sign design in 1990.

buildings.name: 15-17 Flatbush Avenue
buildings.form: Two-storey commercial infill with broad upper windows, a flat coping and shopfronts.
buildings.limitations: Separate old footprint between the restaurant and the taller loft. Signs and the rear return are incompletely resolved.

buildings.name: 560 Fulton Street (later 570)
buildings.form: Three-storey industrial loft, five wide factory-window bays in a pale masonry frame, dark spandrels, shallow cornice and low shopfront band.
buildings.limitations: Photo title is 560 Fulton. Matched by block and lot 35; later redevelopment address is 570. No modern tower is used.

buildings.name: 572 Fulton Street
buildings.geometrySource: Provisional rectangle at lot 35 east party line; not a surveyed footprint
buildings.form: Narrow three-storey shop, four segment-headed upper openings across, cornice, exposed plain end wall.
buildings.limitations: Disputed. A 1980s photo and a 1992 full-demolition filing identify a 30 ft, three-storey building on lot 40. A 2008 archaeological report reading the 1969, 1979 and 1989 Sanborn sheets instead calls the lot parking. Model gives priority to photograph and DOB for existence, using the report's 22 by 40 ft historic dimensions only as a provisional size. View this as a hypothesis.

buildings.name: 33-35 Flatbush Avenue
buildings.form: Restrained neoclassical bank and office loft; six window axes on the upper floors, round-headed top surrounds and a two-level glazed base.
buildings.limitations: Seven visible levels: five over the two-level base. Modern PLUTO counts eight; the photo governs the street elevation. No later movie-set bank name shown.

buildings.name: Pioneer Warehouses / 41 Flatbush Avenue
buildings.form: Romanesque Revival commercial storage complex; broad buff-brick elevation, small dark openings alternating with blind recesses, masonry base, arched entry, ships' prows and dated urns.
buildings.limitations: Modeled before the 2010s office conversion, with blocked openings rather than the present large glazing. Four construction campaigns commemorated: 1896, 1902, 1910, 1914.

buildings.name: 55-57 Flatbush Avenue
buildings.form: Six-storey piano factory with broad industrial sash groups above a glazed showroom.
buildings.limitations: Height estimated from period photo and adjoining cornice; excludes the six-floor residential addition documented in 2007. The modern 171 ft height must not be used.

buildings.name: 59 Flatbush Avenue
buildings.form: Narrow matching white or light-painted loft face, multi-light factory sash, deep shop window and furniture sign.
buildings.limitations: Four small-window upper rows over a showroom and shop read as six levels in the photograph. Cornice steps near the piano factory. Period roof height estimated; later survey records 86 ft and PLUTO seven floors.

buildings.name: 61 Flatbush Avenue
buildings.form: Narrow three-storey shop with plain light masonry and paired rectangular windows.
buildings.limitations: Texture, paint colour, storefront occupancy and rear treatments are approximations.

buildings.name: 63 Flatbush Avenue
buildings.form: Narrow three-storey outfitter; projecting blade, showroom below, blind billboard-bearing side wall to vacant lot.
buildings.limitations: Nevins Uniforms / tuxedo signage appears in tax photograph; graphic lettering and 1990 tenancy are not independently verified. The southern tip is not filled with buildings.

buildings.name: 38 Flatbush Avenue
buildings.form: Triangular postwar office block with horizontal ribbon windows, solid corner piers and recessed dark base, opposite the older lofts.
buildings.limitations: Current outline and height used as proxies; banding follows the tax image rather than later renovations. The Fox Theatre that occupied this block was demolished in 1971.

openSites.name: Break in the street wall, lot 19
openSites.note: Cars in the gap between the loft and bank. Do not insert the present 66 Rockwell tower.
